deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics Subject Test is optional.

gre_general.value: Do not send GRE General scores; they are not accepted.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to the department and identify a research advisor by December 15 of your first year.
supervisor.quote: Each first-year graduate student must identify a research advisor by December 15 of G1.

funding.value: Funding is guaranteed for six years, whichever faculty advisor you choose.
funding.quote: Your funding is guaranteed for six years, regardless of your chosen faculty advisor.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from a recognized institution is accepted.
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

notes: List your four most advanced astronomy and two most advanced mathematics courses in the application. No personal statement.
